newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador March inflation 0.2 percent - ministry.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador March inflation 0.2 percent - ministry.

text.p: Prices in El Salvador rose 0.2 percent in March over February compared with the 0.5 percent rise in February over January, the Economy Ministry said Thursday.

Accumulated inflation for the year to date reached 2.4 percent, slightly above the 2.3 percent recorded in the same three month period a year earlier, it added. Year-on-year inflation was 7.4 percent, it said.
"These results for the first quarter of the year are strongly influenced by the low increases in food prices," a statement from the ministry said.
The government has estimated that inflation for 1997 will end between five and seven percent. Prices rose 7.4 percent in 1996.
